_comment: 1. `universal_genres` is the cross-desk analytical layer. It answers 'what
kind of document is this?' in terms that mean the same thing for a PLA
Daily feature and a US DoD transcript. It lives in core/domain.py and is
listed here only for reference; desks do not get to extend it.
2. `topical_labels` is the China Desk's legacy analytical vocabulary. These
are the 14 category slugs the pipeline already assigns, reproduced
VALID_CATEGORIES. They remain desk-scoped and are not reinterpreted.
The separate cross-desk regional subject layer lives at
taxonomy/regional_topics.v1.json. Similar concepts there do not create
an automatic mapping from these stored China labels.
Nothing in this file changes how categories are assigned today. It records
the existing vocabulary as desk-scoped configuration so a second desk can
declare its own without editing central code.

topical_labels.description: Taiwan Strait, cross-strait military posture, Taiwan-related operations
SCS, Spratly, Paracel, Scarborough Shoal activity
Direct U.S.-China military interactions, FONOPs, intercepts
New platforms, capabilities, defense industry developments
Doctrinal essays, strategic concepts, theoretical writing
Nuclear forces, Rocket Force, strategic weapons
Cyber operations, information warfare, SSF activities
PAP, Xinjiang, Tibet, Hong Kong contingencies
Mil-to-mil diplomacy, exercises with foreign militaries, arms exports
Party-army relations, ideological campaigns within PLA
